title: Crushed Velvet Druqks
prompt: aphex twin style from the druqks album
description: Lush triangle-wave chords cycle through a C minor progression over a CasioRZ1 beat that occasionally crackles with bitcrushing and coarse artifacts. A sawtooth bassline threads through the denser sections while melodic runs scale up and dissolve into a quiet, chord-only outro.

    s("bd ~ ~ bd ~ ~ bd ~").bank("CasioRZ1").gain(0.95),
